text:
Digital Personal Data Protection - Demo Excerpt
SYNTHETIC DEMO EXCERPT: paraphrased for a hackathon demonstration. Not the official text; clause numbering is illustrative. Verify against the official publication.
CHAPTER I Preliminary
1. This excerpt applies to the processing of digital personal data within India.
CHAPTER II Obligations of Data Fiduciary

heading_path: CHAPTER II Obligations of Data Fiduciary
text: 2. A Data Fiduciary shall process personal data only for a lawful purpose for which the Data Principal has given consent or for certain legitimate uses.

heading_path: CHAPTER II Obligations of Data Fiduciary
text: 3. Every request for consent shall be accompanied or preceded by a notice describing the personal data and the purpose of processing.

heading_path: CHAPTER II Obligations of Data Fiduciary
text: 4. The Data Fiduciary shall give the Data Principal the option to access the notice in English or any language specified in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution.

heading_path: CHAPTER II Obligations of Data Fiduciary
text: 5. Consent shall be free, specific, informed, unconditional and unambiguous with a clear affirmative action.

heading_path: CHAPTER II Obligations of Data Fiduciary
text: 6. A Data Fiduciary shall enable the Data Principal to withdraw consent at any time, with the ease of doing so comparable to the ease with which consent was given.

heading_path: CHAPTER II Obligations of Data Fiduciary
text: 7. A Data Fiduciary shall protect personal data by taking reasonable security safeguards to prevent personal data breach.

heading_path: CHAPTER II Obligations of Data Fiduciary
text: 8. In the event of a personal data breach, the Data Fiduciary shall intimate the Data Protection Board and each affected Data Principal.

heading_path: CHAPTER II Obligations of Data Fiduciary
text: 9. A Data Fiduciary shall erase personal data when the purpose is no longer being served or consent is withdrawn, unless retention is necessary for compliance with any law.

heading_path: CHAPTER II Obligations of Data Fiduciary
text: 10. A Data Fiduciary shall publish the business contact information of a person who is able to answer questions of the Data Principal about the processing of personal data.

heading_path: CHAPTER II Obligations of Data Fiduciary
text: 11. Before processing personal data of a child, a Data Fiduciary shall obtain verifiable consent of the parent or lawful guardian.

heading_path: CHAPTER II Obligations of Data Fiduciary
text: 12. A Data Fiduciary shall not undertake tracking, behavioural monitoring or targeted advertising directed at children.
CHAPTER III Significant Data Fiduciary
13. A Significant Data Fiduciary shall appoint a Data Protection Officer based in India.
14. A Significant Data Fiduciary shall undertake a periodic Data Protection Impact Assessment and an independent data audit.
CHAPTER IV Rights of Data Principal

heading_path: CHAPTER IV Rights of Data Principal
text: 15. A Data Fiduciary shall, on request, provide the Data Principal with information about the personal data processed and the processing activities.

heading_path: CHAPTER IV Rights of Data Principal
text: 16. A Data Fiduciary shall give effect to a request of the Data Principal for correction, completion, updating and erasure of personal data.
CHAPTER V Data Protection Board
17. The Central Government shall establish the Data Protection Board of India.
